mapper.select: select DATE_FORMAT(B.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as tradeDate from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B where B.TRADE_ID = #{finprodId}
mapper.update: UPDATE FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT SET PRIN = #{prin,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, VDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), MDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
